source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Un espacio privado para las fotos, las voces y las historias de tu familia.

Agrega un título, unas líneas y una fecha exacta, aproximada o desconocida. Encuentra tus relatos con etiquetas, favoritos y álbumes.

Importa fotos con el selector de documentos y graba un relato de voz. Los archivos se copian al almacenamiento privado de la aplicación.

El audio permanece en este dispositivo. Al salir de la aplicación, la grabación se detiene y se guarda. Las grabaciones gratuitas duran hasta tres minutos.

La función pulsar para hablar usa el servicio de voz del dispositivo, que puede necesitar Internet y procesar la voz fuera del dispositivo. Continúa solo si estás de acuerdo. LifeTalea no guarda el audio de los comandos. Actualmente, los comandos solo están disponibles en inglés.

Compra única prevista: álbumes ilimitados, grabaciones más largas, exportación PDF y copias locales cifradas. El precio de prueba británico propuesto es 4,99 £; Amazon facilitará el precio local real tras la configuración.

Se incluyen historias, transcripciones, álbumes y borradores de libros de recuerdos. Las fotos y grabaciones solo se incluyen si las seleccionas. Las copias exportadas sin cifrar contienen información privada legible. Guarda tu frase de contraseña: no se puede recuperar. Límites actuales: 32 MiB por archivo de copia de seguridad y 16 MiB por archivo adjunto. Las bibliotecas más grandes requieren una versión futura.

Aún no publicada. Siguen en curso las pruebas de dispositivos, la revisión lingüística y la verificación de compras de Amazon.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

draft:
Un espace privé pour les photos, les voix et les histoires de votre famille.

Ajoutez un titre, quelques lignes et une date précise, approximative ou inconnue. Retrouvez vos récits grâce aux étiquettes, aux favoris et aux albums.

Importez des photos avec le sélecteur de documents de l’appareil et enregistrez un récit audio. Les fichiers sont copiés dans le stockage privé de l’application.

L’enregistrement reste sur cet appareil. Si vous quittez l’application, il est arrêté et enregistré. La version gratuite permet des enregistrements de trois minutes maximum.

Le mode appuyer pour parler utilise le service vocal de votre appareil. Ce service peut nécessiter Internet et traiter votre voix en dehors de l’appareil. Continuez uniquement si vous êtes d’accord. LifeTalea n’enregistre pas les commandes audio. Les commandes sont actuellement disponibles uniquement en anglais.

Achat unique prévu : albums illimités, enregistrements plus longs, export PDF et sauvegardes locales chiffrées. Le prix de test britannique proposé est de 4,99 £ ; Amazon fournira le prix local réel après configuration.

Les récits, transcriptions, albums et brouillons de livres sont inclus. Les photos et les enregistrements sont inclus uniquement si vous les sélectionnez. Les exports non chiffrés contiennent des informations privées lisibles. Conservez votre phrase secrète : elle ne peut pas être récupérée. Limites actuelles : 32 MiB par archive et 16 MiB par pièce jointe. Les bibliothèques plus volumineuses nécessitent une future version.

Pas encore publiée. Les tests des appareils, la révision linguistique et la vérification des achats Amazon sont en cours.

La transcription automatique n’est pas configurée dans cette version de LifeTalea. Vous pouvez enregistrer de l’audio et modifier une transcription manuellement.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Een privéplek voor foto’s, stemmen en familieverhalen.

Voeg een titel, tekst en een exacte, geschatte of onbekende datum toe. Vind verhalen terug met tags, favorieten en albums.

Importeer foto’s via de bestandskiezer en neem een verhaal op. De bestanden worden naar de privéopslag van de app gekopieerd.

De opname blijft op dit apparaat. Als je de app verlaat, wordt de opname gestopt en opgeslagen. Gratis opnamen duren maximaal drie minuten.

Drukken om te spreken gebruikt de spraakdienst van je apparaat. Die kan internet nodig hebben en spraak buiten het apparaat verwerken. Ga alleen verder als je hiermee instemt. LifeTalea slaat geen audiocommando’s op. Spraakcommando’s zijn momenteel alleen beschikbaar in het Engels.

Geplande eenmalige aankoop: onbeperkte albums, langere opnamen, PDF-export en versleutelde lokale back-ups. De voorgestelde Britse testprijs is £4,99; Amazon levert na configuratie de echte lokale prijs.

Verhalen, transcripties, albums en boekconcepten worden opgenomen. Foto’s en opnamen worden alleen opgenomen als je ze selecteert. Onversleutelde exports bevatten leesbare privégegevens. Bewaar je wachtzin veilig: deze kan niet worden hersteld. Huidige limieten: 32 MiB per archief en 16 MiB per bijlage. Grotere bibliotheken vereisen een toekomstige versie.

Nog niet gepubliceerd. Apparaattests, taalcontrole en verificatie van Amazon-aankopen lopen nog.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

En privat plats för foton, röster och familjeberättelser.

Lägg till titel, text och ett exakt, ungefärligt eller okänt datum. Hitta berättelser med taggar, favoriter och album.

Importera foton med dokumentväljaren och spela in en berättelse. Filerna kopieras till appens privata lagring.

Inspelningen stannar på den här enheten. När du lämnar appen stoppas och sparas den. Gratis inspelningar kan vara upp till tre minuter långa.

Tryck för att tala använder enhetens taltjänst. Den kan behöva internet och behandla tal utanför enheten. Fortsätt bara om du samtycker. LifeTalea sparar inte ljud från kommandon. Röstkommandon stöds för närvarande endast på engelska.

Planerat engångsköp: obegränsade album, längre inspelningar, PDF-export och krypterade lokala säkerhetskopior. Föreslaget brittiskt testpris är 4,99 £; Amazon visar det riktiga lokala priset efter konfiguration.

Ännu inte publicerad. Enhetstester, språkgranskning och verifiering av Amazon-köp pågår.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

परिवार की तस्वीरों, आवाज़ों और कहानियों के लिए एक निजी जगह।

शीर्षक, कुछ पंक्तियाँ और सटीक, अनुमानित या अज्ञात तारीख जोड़ें। टैग, पसंदीदा और एल्बम से कहानी फिर खोजें।

डिवाइस के फ़ाइल चयन से तस्वीरें लाएँ और कहानी रिकॉर्ड करें। फ़ाइलें ऐप के निजी स्टोरेज में कॉपी होती हैं।

रिकॉर्डिंग इसी डिवाइस पर रहती है। ऐप से बाहर जाने पर रिकॉर्डिंग रुककर सेव हो जाती है। मुफ़्त रिकॉर्डिंग अधिकतम तीन मिनट की हो सकती है।

बोलने के लिए दबाने की सुविधा आपके डिवाइस की वाक् सेवा का उपयोग करती है। इस सेवा को इंटरनेट की आवश्यकता हो सकती है और यह डिवाइस के बाहर आवाज़ को संसाधित कर सकती है। सहमत होने पर ही आगे बढ़ें। LifeTalea आवाज़ वाले आदेशों की रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं सहेजता। फ़िलहाल आदेश केवल अंग्रेज़ी में उपलब्ध हैं।

नियोजित एकमुश्त खरीद में असीमित एल्बम, लंबी रिकॉर्डिंग, PDF निर्यात और एन्क्रिप्टेड लोकल बैकअप हैं। प्रस्तावित ब्रिटिश परीक्षण मूल्य £4.99 है; कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के बाद Amazon वास्तविक स्थानीय मूल्य देगा।

कहानियाँ, प्रतिलिपियाँ, एल्बम और किताबों के मसौदे शामिल हैं। फ़ोटो और रिकॉर्डिंग केवल आपके चुनने पर शामिल की जाती हैं। बिना एन्क्रिप्शन के निर्यात में निजी जानकारी पढ़ी जा सकती है। अपना पासफ़्रेज़ सुरक्षित रखें; उसे वापस नहीं पाया जा सकता। मौजूदा सीमा: हर संग्रह के लिए 32 MiB और हर संलग्न फ़ाइल के लिए 16 MiB। बड़ी लाइब्रेरी के लिए भविष्य का संस्करण चाहिए।

ऐप अभी प्रकाशित नहीं हुआ है। डिवाइस परीक्षण, मातृभाषी समीक्षा और Amazon खरीदारी की जाँच जारी है।

इस LifeTalea संस्करण में स्वचालित लिखित प्रतिलिपि कॉन्फ़िगर नहीं है। रिकॉर्डिंग और प्रतिलिपि का मैन्युअल संपादन उपलब्ध है।

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

استورد الصور عبر منتقي المستندات وسجّل قصة صوتية. تُنسخ الملفات إلى مساحة التخزين الخاصة بالتطبيق.

يبقى التسجيل على هذا الجهاز. عند مغادرة التطبيق، يتوقف التسجيل ويُحفظ. مدة التسجيل المجاني ثلاث دقائق كحد أقصى.

تستخدم ميزة الضغط للتحدث خدمة الكلام على جهازك، وقد تحتاج هذه الخدمة إلى الإنترنت وتعالج الكلام خارج الجهاز. تابع فقط إذا وافقت على ذلك. لا يحفظ LifeTalea صوت الأوامر. الأوامر مدعومة حاليًا باللغة الإنجليزية فقط.

شراء مخطط لمرة واحدة: ألبومات غير محدودة وتسجيلات أطول وتصدير PDF ونسخ محلية مشفرة. سعر الاختبار البريطاني المقترح £4.99؛ وتوفر Amazon السعر المحلي الفعلي بعد الإعداد.

تتضمن النسخة القصص والنصوص المكتوبة للتسجيلات والألبومات ومسودات كتب الذكريات. تُضمّن الصور والتسجيلات فقط عند اختيارها. تحتوي النسخ المصدّرة غير المشفّرة على معلومات خاصة قابلة للقراءة. احتفظ بعبارة المرور، إذ لا يمكن استعادتها. الحدود الحالية: 32 MiB لكل أرشيف و16 MiB لكل مرفق. تحتاج المكتبات الأكبر إلى إصدار مستقبلي.

لم يُنشر التطبيق بعد. اختبارات الأجهزة والمراجعة اللغوية والتحقق من مشتريات Amazon ما زالت جارية.

لم يُعدّ التفريغ التلقائي في هذا الإصدار من LifeTalea. يمكن التسجيل وتحرير النصوص يدويًا.

مسودة ترجمة. المراجعة اللغوية لم تكتمل بعد.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

draft:
Fotoğraflar, sesler ve aile hikâyeleri için özel bir alan.

Başlık, birkaç satır ve kesin, yaklaşık ya da bilinmeyen bir tarih ekleyin. Hikâyeleri etiketler, favoriler ve albümlerle bulun.

Belge seçiciyle fotoğraf alın ve sesli hikâye kaydedin. Dosyalar uygulamanın özel depolama alanına kopyalanır.

Kayıt bu cihazda kalır. Uygulamadan çıktığınızda kayıt durdurulur ve kaydedilir. Ücretsiz kayıtlar en fazla üç dakika olabilir.

Bas konuş özelliği cihazınızın konuşma hizmetini kullanır. Bu hizmet internete ihtiyaç duyabilir ve konuşmayı cihaz dışında işleyebilir. Yalnızca kabul ediyorsanız devam edin. LifeTalea sesli komut kayıtlarını saklamaz. Komutlar şu anda yalnızca İngilizce olarak desteklenmektedir.

Planlanan tek seferlik satın alım: sınırsız albüm, uzun kayıtlar, PDF ve şifreli yerel yedekler. Önerilen Birleşik Krallık test fiyatı £4.99’dur; yapılandırma sonrası gerçek yerel fiyatı Amazon sağlar.

Hikâyeler, konuşma metinleri, albümler ve kitap taslakları dahildir. Fotoğraf ve kayıtlar yalnızca seçildiğinde eklenir. Şifrelenmemiş dışa aktarmalar okunabilir özel bilgiler içerir. Parolanızı güvenli saklayın; geri alınamaz. Güncel sınırlar: arşiv başına 32 MiB ve ek başına 16 MiB. Daha büyük kitaplıklar için gelecekteki bir sürüm gereklidir.

Henüz yayımlanmadı. Cihaz testleri, ana dil incelemesi ve Amazon satın alma doğrulaması sürüyor.

Bu LifeTalea sürümünde otomatik ses dökümü yapılandırılmamıştır. Kayıt ve elle döküm düzenleme kullanılabilir.

Çeviri taslağı. Ana dil incelemesi bekleniyor.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

draft:
가족의 사진과 목소리, 이야기를 위한 나만의 공간.

제목과 글을 쓰고 정확한 날짜, 대략적인 날짜 또는 날짜 모름을 선택하세요. 태그, 즐겨찾기, 앨범으로 다시 찾을 수 있습니다.

기기의 문서 선택기로 사진을 가져오고 음성 이야기를 녹음하세요. 파일은 앱 전용 비공개 저장 공간에 복사됩니다.

녹음은 이 기기에 저장됩니다. 앱을 벗어나면 녹음이 중지되고 저장됩니다. 무료 녹음은 최대 3분까지 가능합니다.

눌러서 말하기 기능은 기기의 음성 서비스를 사용합니다. 이 서비스는 인터넷 연결이 필요하거나 기기 외부에서 음성을 처리할 수 있습니다. 동의하는 경우에만 계속하세요. LifeTalea는 음성 명령의 녹음 파일을 저장하지 않습니다. 현재 명령은 영어로만 지원됩니다.

계획된 일회성 구매: 무제한 앨범, 긴 녹음, PDF 내보내기, 암호화된 로컬 백업입니다. 영국 테스트 제안 가격은 £4.99이며 설정 후 Amazon의 실제 현지 가격을 표시합니다.

이야기, 녹음의 텍스트, 앨범과 책 초안이 포함됩니다. 사진과 녹음은 선택한 경우에만 포함됩니다. 암호화되지 않은 내보내기에는 읽을 수 있는 개인정보가 포함됩니다. 암호 문구는 복구할 수 없으므로 안전하게 보관하세요. 현재 한도는 전체 보관 파일당 32 MiB, 첨부 파일당 16 MiB입니다. 더 큰 라이브러리는 향후 버전이 필요합니다.

아직 출시되지 않았습니다. 기기 테스트, 원어민 검토, Amazon 구매 검증을 진행 중입니다.

이 LifeTalea 버전에는 자동 녹취 기능이 설정되어 있지 않습니다. 녹음과 녹취록 직접 편집은 가능합니다.

번역 초안입니다. 원어민 검토가 아직 필요합니다.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.
